text:
### Operational KRIs  
| KRI | Target | Action if Exceeded |
|-----|--------|-------------------|
| Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff |
| System availability | 99.8% | Investigate outage, remediate |
| Reconciliation variance | <£1k daily | Investigate, correct |
| Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps |
| Compliance violations | 0 | Immediate remediation |
| Customer complaints | <2 per 1,000 accounts | Root cause analysis |
name: Chunk 23/32

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Error
raw_entities.description: Operational risk relating to errors occurring during the account opening process. The policy establishes a target threshold of less than 0.5% error rate, with remediation through process review and staff retraining when exceeded.
context: Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff

raw_entities.name: System Availability Failure
raw_entities.description: Operational risk of system downtime or unavailability affecting banking operations. The policy establishes a target of 99.8% availability, with investigation and remediation required when this threshold is not met.
context: System availability | 99.8% | Investigate outage, remediate

raw_entities.name: Reconciliation Variance
raw_entities.description: Operational risk arising from discrepancies between recorded and actual account balances or transaction records. The policy establishes a daily variance threshold of less than £1,000, requiring investigation and correction when exceeded.
context: Reconciliation variance | <£1k daily | Investigate, correct

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Gap
raw_entities.description: Risk that fraudulent transactions or activities are not detected by the bank's fraud monitoring systems. The policy establishes a target detection rate of 97% or higher, with tuning of fraud rules and investigation of detection gaps when the target is not met.
context: Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps

raw_entities.name: Compliance Violation
raw_entities.description: Risk of breaching regulatory or internal policy requirements. The policy establishes a zero-tolerance target for compliance violations, with immediate remediation required upon any occurrence.
context: Compliance violations | 0 | Immediate remediation

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint Volume
raw_entities.description: Operational and reputational risk arising from customer dissatisfaction and formal complaints. The policy establishes a target threshold of fewer than 2 complaints per 1,000 accounts, with root cause analysis required when exceeded.
context: Customer complaints | <2 per 1,000 accounts | Root cause analysis

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Process Review
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring review of the account opening process when error rates exceed the 0.5% threshold. This is part of the operational KRI framework to identify and remediate systemic issues in account setup procedures.
context: Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff

raw_entities.name: Staff Retraining on Account Opening
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring staff retraining when account opening error rates exceed 0.5%. This addresses root causes of operational errors through targeted staff development.
context: Account opening errors | <0.5% | Review process, retrain staff

raw_entities.name: System Outage Investigation and Remediation
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring investigation and remediation of system outages when availability falls below the 99.8% target. This ensures rapid response to service disruptions.
context: System availability | 99.8% | Investigate outage, remediate

raw_entities.name: Reconciliation Variance Investigation
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring investigation and correction of reconciliation variances exceeding £1,000 daily. This ensures accuracy of financial records and account balances.
context: Reconciliation variance | <£1k daily | Investigate, correct

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Rule Tuning
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring adjustment and optimization of fraud detection rules when the fraud detection rate falls below 97%. This ensures the fraud monitoring system remains effective.
context: Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Gap Investigation
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring investigation of undetected fraudulent transactions when the fraud detection rate falls below 97%. This identifies weaknesses in fraud monitoring coverage.
context: Fraud detection rate | 97%+ | Tune fraud rules, investigate gaps

raw_entities.name: Compliance Violation Remediation
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring immediate remediation of any compliance violations. The policy establishes zero tolerance for breaches, with urgent corrective action mandated.
context: Compliance violations | 0 | Immediate remediation

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaint Root Cause Analysis
raw_entities.description: Control measure requiring root cause analysis of customer complaints when the complaint rate exceeds 2 per 1,000 accounts. This identifies systemic issues affecting customer satisfaction.
context: Customer complaints | <2 per 1,000 accounts | Root cause analysis
